que_es: Accumulated radiation received by the crew, measured by the area dosimeter of the mission profile.
por_que: HRP risk: radiation-induced cancers. Feeds the accumulated dose counter of each profile.
referencia_en_vuelo: On the ISS the effective dose accumulates at about 0.2 to 0.5 mSv per day, between 40 and 90 mSv in a typical six-month mission. Neutrons contribute about 30% and the detectors used do not separate that component.
cuando_avisar: Career limit of 600 mSv and a limit of 250 mSv per solar particle event. A proton flux of 10 or more at ≥10 MeV activates storm mode.
prevencion: Keep the dose as low as reasonably achievable (ALARA): storm shelter during proton events, passive shielding in the crew quarters and planning of extravehicular activities according to space weather.
fuentes: NASA OCHMO: radiation protection technical brief
